comment: FRAGILE, BY DESIGN. ClassRegistry.RegisterentityBehavior uses Dictionary.Add (VintagestoryLib, ClassRegistry.cs:442), so 'bodytemperature' cannot be re-registered with our subclass: the entity has to name ours instead. JsonPatch has no way to address an array element by value, so this is the index of the bodytemperature entry in 1.22.7's game:entities/humanoid/player.json (client behaviors, line 326). Vanilla patches player.json the same way (survival/patches/playerhealthpoints.json points at /server/behaviors/4). If a game update or another mod shifts that array, this patch silently rewrites the WRONG behavior: the scenario Player_body_temperature_uses_our_behavior is what catches it. JsonPatch has no comment field, but ModJsonPatchLoader deserializes with default Newtonsoft settings, so an unknown key is ignored.

Same entry on the server list (line 4305, index 10). The domain on 'file' is not optional here: JsonUtil.ToObject adds an AssetLocationJsonParser bound to the patch file's own domain when it is not 'game' (JsonUtil.cs:95), so a bare path would resolve to caminus:entities/humanoid/player.json and the patch would be logged as a missing file.
